final: SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.country) AS ratio FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.date BETWEEN '1978-03-04' AND '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
